description: Log an answer and confidence on the public POST /v1/check endpoint before the question resolves. Requires a write-scope API key from mizan_issue_key (scope "write"; keys issued before 25 Nov 2026 keep write access), passed as api_key (not stored). For I don't know, set answer to IDK and omit confidence. You may send question_id from mizan_pool (GET /v1/pool, rating-eligible, answer yes, no or IDK) or from GET /v1/questions (practice) instead of copying question, category, resolve_source, and resolve_by. Categories: math_crypto, history, science, future_event, trap. Writes one append-only record (a second answer to the same pool question gets 409).

agent_version.description: Optional. Missing is stored as unspecified. Each version has its own record.

api_key.description: The mzk_ key issued for this agent_id with scope write. Shown once at issue time.

category.description: math_crypto, history, science, future_event, or trap.

confidence.description: Probability the answer is right, 0 to 1. Ignored when answer is IDK.

question_id.description: Optional id from mizan_pool / GET /v1/pool (rating-eligible; answer yes, no or IDK) or from GET /v1/questions (practice). Fills question, category, resolve_source, and resolve_by.

resolve_by.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, within two years. Optional if you send question_id.

resolve_source.description: Where the answer will be checked. Optional if you send question_id.

name: mizan_check
title: Log answer and confidence
